comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts robot hardware; this record rinses highlighted teeth, evacuates water, and returns dental tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses concentric rotary tools; the record coordinates irrigator coverage and suction placement, including timed post-rinse clearance and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained mechanical motion; the record checks crown wetting, water recovery, spill limits, near-dry final state, tool poses, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Coordinated liquid delivery and evacuation have different manipulation, hazards, and observable outcomes from threaded adjustment.
